name: Picnic spot
about: A checked picnic blanket with a basket, under a little oak tree.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Dig a short path at the front right and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Blanket and tree
layers.tip: Lay red and white carpet in a checked square for the blanket. A barrel beside it is the basket. Start the tree with a log, and plant some flowers.

layers.name: Tree trunk
layers.tip: One more log on the tree.

layers.name: Leaves
layers.tip: A last log, with leaves all around it. Collect leaves with shears.

layers.name: More leaves
layers.tip: A square of leaves on top.

layers.name: Treetop
layers.tip: Five leaves in a plus shape finish the tree. Leaves you place yourself never fall.
